---
title: Truffle Pâté
id: MAR-0056
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 50
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 150 g veal liver
- 150 g chicken liver
- 150 g butter
- 15 g white truffle
- 2 sage
- 1 rosemary sprig
- 1 tablespoon Marsala wine
- 1 tablespoon rum
- 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Clean the chicken liver and the veal liver, wash them several times and cut them into small pieces.
2. Heat the oil and 20 g butter in a non-stick pan, in which you will add the pieces of liver with the sage and rosemary.
3. Let it flavor for a few minutes over low heat, pour in the Marsala wine and let it evaporate.
4. Season with salt and pepper, then turn off the heat.
5. Pass the mixture through a sieve, collecting it in a bowl.
6. Work the butter at room temperature and add it to the mixture.
7. Combine the ingredients, stirring with a wooden spoon, moisten with the rum and continue stirring.
8. Finally add the white truffle cut into slices, then mix, level the surface and cover the bowl.
9. Let it rest in the refrigerator until the pâté has hardened.
